note: P04 energy service and critical-infrastructure model for the fictional reference site REF-ENERGY-001. Every number carries a 'source' of exactly one kind: 'simulator_config' (recorded in evidence/backend-loss/04-edge-config-discovery.json or data/measurement-dictionary.json), 'assumption' (an explicitly labelled example value, not a vendor or operator limit) or 'derived' (calculated from the two kinds above; the calculation is shown in docs/18-service-model.md). No physical test was performed. States, transitions and KPIs describe how the laboratory would classify simulator output; they are not a claim about real equipment.

context.description: Example commercial microgrid: PV, one battery energy storage system (ESS), a grid connection, one critical load and one deferrable load. The recorded simulator has a single consumption channel; the load split below is a modelling assumption that EXP-05 or later would have to implement as two simulated meters.

grid_mode.ref: ess0.gridMode; grid loss was never simulated

fuse_limit_a.ref: _meta.gridConnectionPointFuseLimit; recorded but not enforced by any controller in the configuration

minimum_service_level.statement: |GridActivePower| <= 50 W in every cycle while ST-NORMAL or ST-CENTRAL-LOST applies
critical-service fulfilment ratio (KPI-CSF-001) = 1.00 over any 60 s window

outage_tolerance.statement: no interruption of the critical load is tolerated while ESS energy above the reserve floor remains

reserve_autonomy_h.rationale: example planning horizon for the critical load with no grid and no PV; not a vendor or operator figure

minimum_service_level.statement: none; may be curtailed to 0 W in ST-SAFE-CURTAIL

outage_tolerance.rationale: example: the deferrable load may be shifted by up to 4 h

minimum_service_level.statement: local record continuous at 1 s; central history complete after backfill

outage_tolerance.rationale: nominal resend scheduling delay 5 to 65 min recorded in docs/13-sc06-root-cause.md, rounded up; central visibility may be absent this long without breaching the local record

tiers.name: critical
tiers.rule: must be served; the reserve floor exists for this tier only

tiers.name: economic
tiers.rule: balancing function; may be limited when a limit or the reserve floor is reached

tiers.name: deferrable or informational
tiers.rule: may be curtailed or delayed within its outage tolerance

power_w.rationale: example constant critical demand; about half of the 4100 W consumption recorded in the connected baseline of evidence/backend-loss/11-final-reconciliation-run.json

loads.note: not a separate channel in the recorded configuration; _sum/ConsumptionActivePower is one aggregate

power_w.rationale: example maximum deferrable demand; with LOAD-CRIT-001 it brackets the 1800 to 5200 W consumption range recorded in the v1 evidence

curtail_latency_s.rationale: one controller cycle in simulation; no physical switching modelled

limits.calculation: reserve_wh = 2000 W x 2 h = 4000 Wh; 4000 / 10200 = 39.2 %, rounded up to 40 %

limits.rationale: exit hysteresis above the floor; the SoC channel is an integer percentage, so 1 % would chatter

limits.calculation: 3 phases x 230 V x 32 A = 22080 W; 32 A is the recorded fuse config value, 3 x 230 V is an assumption; not enforced by any recorded controller

local_record_gap_tolerance_s.rationale: example: a gap longer than 60 consecutive 1 s samples in the local record is a loss event

central_backfill_window_min.rationale: nominal resend delay upper bound from docs/13-sc06-root-cause.md; a separate transfer timeout must be recorded per run

central_permanent_loss_tolerance_wh.rationale: example target: no energy record permanently missing from central history after the backfill window; FND-REC-001 remains open until EXP-02 measures this

control_reaction_objective_s.rationale: two controller cycles of 1 s; simulation-only, no inverter ramp modelled

link_loss_detection_objective_s.rationale: example; the v1 evidence shows UnableToSend rising within the 12 s snapshot spacing, so the objective is not tight

equations.sign_convention: ESS positive = discharge to the site; grid positive = import (data/measurement-dictionary.json)
equations.power_balance: P_prod + P_ess + P_grid - P_cons = residual; |residual| <= 50 W
equations.soc_evolution: SoC(t + dt) = SoC(t) - 100 * (P_ess * dt / 3600) / C, with P_ess in W, dt in s, C = 10200 Wh, SoC in %
equations.energy_not_supplied: ENS = sum over cycles of max(0, P_crit_demand - P_crit_served) * dt / 3600, in Wh
equations.critical_fulfilment_ratio: CSF = 1 - ENS / (P_crit_demand * T / 3600) over a window of T seconds
equations.worked_check: 3000 W discharge for 41 s = 34.2 Wh = 0.335 % of 10200 Wh; the integer SoC channel staying at 28 % across the 41 s v1 run is consistent with the equation
equations.note: These equations describe the simulator. They say nothing about physical safety of real equipment.

states.name: normal
states.entry: all required channels fresh (LIM-STALE-*), backend link up, LIM-GRID-BAL met, LIM-SOC-FLOOR + LIM-SOC-HYST < SoC < 100, no limit violation
states.exit: the entry condition of any other state holds
states.evidence_now: evidence/backend-loss/11-final-reconciliation-run.json connected_baseline (except the SoC floor, which is below the example floor)

states.name: central-connectivity-lost
states.entry: backend link down (relay port 18081 closed or ctrlBackend0 UnableToSend > 0) while local channels are fresh

states.name: unreliable-measurement
states.entry: any required channel older than its stale_after_s, or |residual| > 50 W, or a value outside physical bounds (SoC outside 0-100, |P_ess| > 10000)
states.exit: two consecutive cycles fresh and consistent (assumption) -> previous state; if held longer than 30 s (assumption) -> ST-SAFE-CURTAIL

states.name: capacity-limit
states.entry: SoC <= 40 % while balancing requests discharge, or SoC >= 100 % while balancing requests charge, or requested |P_ess| > 10000 W
states.exit: SoC > 42 % (floor + hysteresis) or request within limits
states.expected_behaviour: non-zero grid exchange is correct here, not a violation (measurement-dictionary soc_limit_note)
states.evidence_now: 11-final run SoC 28 % is below the example floor; the simulator did not limit because it enforces 0 %

states.name: safe-curtailment
states.entry: ST-CAP-LIMIT with grid supply unavailable, or ST-MEAS-UNRELIABLE held longer than 30 s
states.action: LOAD-DEF-001 set to 0 W; ESS serves LOAD-CRIT-001 only
states.exit: entry condition cleared and operator acknowledgement recorded -> ST-RECOVERY
states.note: grid loss is not in the recorded configuration; no curtailment controller exists in it

states.name: recovery
states.entry: a lost dependency returned or ST-SAFE-CURTAIL cleared
states.exit: to ST-NORMAL when LastSuccessfulResend is non-null and the central record matches the local record within the backfill window; to a flagged ST-NORMAL with an FND-REC-001-type finding if the transfer timeout expires
states.evidence_now: after_reconnection snapshot; exit never observed (SC-06 INCONCLUSIVE)

priority_rule: When two entry conditions hold, the state with the lower priority number is reported; the other condition is recorded as a concurrent flag. Safety of the critical load (1) beats measurement doubt (2), which beats an energy limit (3), which beats loss of the central link (4). Recovery (5) is reported only when nothing else is active.

transitions.trigger: SoC reaches floor or ceiling, or power request exceeds LIM-ESS-P
SoC beyond hysteresis band or request within limits
grid supply unavailable while at floor
transitions.evidence: not obtainable from the recorded configuration

transitions.trigger: floor or limit reached while the link is down
transitions.note: priority 3 beats 4; ST-CENTRAL-LOST stays as a flag

dependencies.name: electricity supply (grid)
dependencies.failure_effect: balancing cannot hold 0 W; ESS alone serves load until LIM-SOC-FLOOR
dependencies.lab_method: simulator gridMode OFF_GRID; not yet run

dependencies.name: network path Edge to Backend
dependencies.failure_effect: central visibility and transfer lost; local control unaffected

dependencies.name: time source
dependencies.failure_effect: evidence cannot be ordered (SC-05); state durations and KPI-TRL-001 become unmeasurable
dependencies.lab_method: host UTC only; no independent clock

dependencies.name: name resolution and identity
dependencies.failure_effect: Edge cannot reach or authenticate to Backend (uri ws://localhost:18081, apikey); operator cannot log in
dependencies.lab_method: localhost only; DNS is not exercised in this laboratory

dependencies.name: storage (local RRD4J, central InfluxDB)
dependencies.failure_effect: local record gap or central history loss; ST-RECOVERY cannot exit cleanly

dependencies.name: shared host (single Codespace)
dependencies.failure_effect: control, management plane and evidence pipeline fail together

dependencies.name: operator
dependencies.failure_effect: no acknowledgement for TR-10; no manual intervention during ST-SAFE-CURTAIL

dependencies.name: supply chain (OpenEMS build and libraries)
dependencies.failure_effect: control logic or resend behaviour changes with an upstream revision; results are tied to the pinned build

common_cause_groups.effect: one host failure removes service, management and evidence at once; only failures injectable above the host can be isolated
all channels and all timestamps come from one host clock; residual and ordering checks are consistency checks, not independent measurements
Edge and Backend share one upstream revision; a defect affects both sides of D-001

kpis.name: critical-service fulfilment ratio
kpis.method: 1 - ENS / (2000 W x T / 3600) over window T; needs a separate critical-load channel
kpis.source_channel: none in the recorded config; requires a second simulated consumption meter

kpis.name: energy not supplied to the critical load
kpis.method: sum of max(0, demand - served) x dt / 3600 at 1 s
kpis.source_channel: requires grid-loss simulation (gridMode OFF_GRID) and a load split; no physical meaning in this laboratory

kpis.name: limit violations (count)
kpis.method: number of samples where LIM-GRID-BAL fails outside ST-CAP-LIMIT, |P_ess| > 10000 W, or SoC < 40 % without ST-CAP-LIMIT declared
kpis.current_value: 0 grid or power violations in 4 snapshots; SoC 28 % is below the example floor in all 4 (floor not enforced by simulator)

kpis.name: limit violations (duration)
kpis.method: sum of sample intervals in violation; resolution equals sample spacing
kpis.current_value: resolution about 12 s (snapshot spacing); 0 s for grid and power; SoC floor breached for the whole 41 s window

kpis.name: transition latency
kpis.method: time from trigger sample to first sample in the new state, at 1 s sampling
kpis.source_channel: 1 s channel log; v1 snapshots at about 12 s are too coarse

kpis.name: central-loss detection latency
kpis.method: time from relay stop to UnableToSend > 0
kpis.source_channel: ctrlBackend0 UnableToSend; v1 bound: within 12 s

kpis.name: recovery time to verified central history
kpis.method: time from link restoration to LastSuccessfulResend non-null and central record matching local record

downstream_packages.P05: needs LOAD-* as two simulated meters, DEP-NET per site, and KPI-LINK-001 / KPI-TRL-001 at 1 s sampling
downstream_packages.P06: needs the SoC equation, LIM-* and state entry conditions as the deterministic core of Monte Carlo runs
downstream_packages.P07: needs KPI-CSF-001, KPI-ENS-001 and KPI-REC-001 as the quantities whose distributions are estimated; CCG-* as correlation structure
